title: Luxuriously Roasted Korean Vin Santo Hwajeon
description: A rich and indulgent Korean dessert featuring Vin Santo wine, with a crispy exterior and a soft interior, perfect for special occasions. This dish is onion and garlic free, making it suitable for those with dietary restrictions.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the rice flour, cornstarch, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the melted butter, egg, and water.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and brush with Vin Santo wine.
Sprinkle the tops with sesame seeds and pine nuts.
Place the disks on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes before serving.
